structural_review: Guardian/release known_owned contains only identities recorded in this run's process group/session, not a host-wide process list. Environment evidence contains a small named variable selection for the matching server.
retained_bookkeeping_identifiers: Historical initializer/reservation tokens, own process identities, GPU UUID and runtime paths are retained in byte-preserved release/initialization evidence. They are task bookkeeping identities, not account access credentials.
limitations: Focused pattern and structural review, not exhaustive secret detection.
retained_owner_audit_scope: Raw owner fresh-audit process inventory is excluded; only aggregate own-cleanup fields and source SHA are published. Guardian/release originals retain their already scoped own-process lineage.
